symptoms.name: Intermittent Connectivity
root_causes: Not specified USB cable used to PC (above max. specified range) [CM]
Loose micro-B USB interface (no cable clip used) [CM]

symptoms.name: Previous (Patient) Image
root_causes: Second (rescue) image transfer path in IOSS [SW]

symptoms.name: Images not transferred
root_causes: Software can trigger a FPGA reset [SW]
More than one USB3 remote connected to acquisition PC [CM]
SW allocates too small buffer size [SW]

symptoms.name: Loosening Screws
root_causes: Incorrect torque used during sensor cable exchange [CM]
Vibration / sensor handling loosens the connection [HW]

symptoms.name: No Power / "Dying Boxes" (USB module)
root_causes: Electrostatic discharge (ESD) at the interfaces of the USB3 remote [HW]
Firmware update bricked the USB3 remote [SW]

symptoms.name: Inconstant/wrong signaling (SW vs. Interface)
root_causes: Workflow sequence not correctly used by 3rd party SW [SW]
Missing signals/state changes from USB3 remote to PC [SW]
symptoms.hint: Acquisition SW must correctly display the system status.

symptoms.name: Overexposed images
root_causes: Error in the image processing path [SW]
Different implementation for dark image substraction [SW]

symptoms.name: White Images
root_causes: Sensor triggers by the influence of an electric field [HW]
Sensor housing allows light to pass through [HW]
Wrong alignment X-Ray generator and sensor (user fault) [CM]
Sensor permanently armed (scattering X-Ray, background accumulation) [SW]

symptoms.name: Interface Update Issues
root_causes: Power cycling the RAM during update corrupts the update file [HW]
Driver conflicts after IOSS/CDR reinstall for 3rd party [SW]
